risks.title: heading_command defaults to True and the Go2 config does not override it
risks.evidence: HiRA/legged_gym_go2/legged_gym/envs/base/legged_robot_config.py:44 (heading_command = True); go2/go2_config.py defines GO2RoughCfg.env but no commands override
risks.impact: an externally written yaw-rate command may be recomputed from heading error at command resampling, silently rewriting what the policy sees
risks.verified_in_task: HIRA-016 (external command not silently rewritten), also HIRA-013 (command slice of the observation)
risks.verification_method: hold commands[:, :3] fixed across at least one resample period, log the command actually consumed by the policy, diff against what was written

risks.title: PD is recomputed inside every physics substep, not once per policy step
risks.impact: an Isaac Lab adapter that computes torque once per policy step and holds it for four substeps changes both the trajectory and the 200 Hz energy integral
risks.verified_in_task: HIRA-014 (per-substep PD) and HIRA-019 (real 200 Hz torque and energy metering)
risks.verification_method: single-step oracle comparison of the four torques emitted inside one policy step for identical state and action

risks.title: Source reset randomises joint angles and drops the robot from 1 m
risks.evidence: base/legged_robot.py:_reset_dofs uses default_dof_pos * torch_rand_float(0.5, 1.5); base/legged_robot_config.py:52 init_state.pos = [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]
risks.impact: the collection semantics require a fixed start pose and seed-reproducible rollouts; inheriting the training reset would make every trial differ
risks.verified_in_task: HIRA-016 (reset and previous-action cleared per env) and HIRA-012 (robot and actuator config)
risks.verification_method: two runs with the same seed must produce identical first-frame joint positions and root pose, or the divergence must be documented as intentional

risks.title: action_scale has two sources (0.5 in the base config, 0.25 in the Go2 config)
risks.evidence: base/legged_robot_config.py:66 action_scale = 0.5; go2/go2_config.py control block action_scale = 0.25; the Go2 subclass wins
risks.impact: a factor-of-two error changes the policy behaviour completely while still producing a walking robot, so it can pass a naive smoke test
risks.verified_in_task: HIRA-008 (freeze the interface contract) and HIRA-014
risks.verification_method: oracle against the source _compute_torques for the same action, plus an explicit assertion that the resolved scale is 0.25 in both the adapter and its test

risks.title: Shared machine: foreign GPU memory, high load, 96 percent disk
risks.evidence: GPU0 held by two katago processes, GPU1 by another user's python; load average 172; /pub 27T of 29T used
risks.impact: GPU 0 is known to stall Isaac startup when katago is busy; batch size and throughput must be re-measured, and a second 70 GB data set must be budgeted
risks.verification_method: use a free GPU index per run, record utilisation and wall time for the first pilot batch, register the measured numbers before the formal runs

risks.title: Retry semantics changed: a successful retry may not replace a business failure
risks.evidence: plan repeated_calibration_contract.retry; calibration README rewritten on 2026-11-05 stating the v2 one-off refill is not to be generalised
risks.impact: the v2 near-obstacle cell that was refilled from 8/10 to 9/10 stays a historical exception; a HiRA trial that fails stays in the main denominator with all attempts
risks.verified_in_task: HIRA-023 (counting priority and tests) and HIRA-024 (lock)
risks.verification_method: collector test that a terminated trial is counted as failed and that a retry does not displace it from the denominator
